description: Get deep personalized astrological interpretation for canonical life pillars or placements (e.g. 'career_and_vocation', 'relationships', 'dasha_analysis', 'wealth_and_finance', 'health_and_vitality'). Corresponds to the /interpret slash command in Discord and Google Chat. Can be run with or without specific birth details.

birth_country.title: Birth Country

birth_date.description: Explicit alias for natal birth date (YYYY-MM-DD)
birth_date.title: Birth Date

city.description: Optional birth city for natal chart mapping
city.title: City

platform.title: Platform

time.description: Optional birth time in 24-hour HH:MM format (default '12:00')
